### Our Promise-Keeping Lord
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/our-promise-keeping-lord
Passage: Joshua 21:41-45
Points:
- The Levites did not receive an undivided territorial allotment, but forty-eight cities throughout Israel from which to teach God's law.
- Joshua 21 concludes the initial conquest and land division by celebrating that God brought all His promises to pass.
- Even though pockets of land remained to be occupied, the victory in substance proved God's faithfulness and encouraged Israel to persevere.
- The Christian faith rests upon God's unchanging trustworthiness to bring every promise to completion.

### A Prayer for Celebrating God's Faithfulness in Hard Times
Author: Christine F. Perry
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-celebrating-gods-faithfulness-in-hard-times.html
Passage: Joshua 21:45
Points:
- Joshua 21:45 celebrates that God delivered on every good promise spoken to Israel after their wilderness journeys.
- Difficult circumstances often tempt believers to forget God's past victories and view Him through a negative lens.
- God's love is unconditional and not tied to personal performance or circumstances.
- Noticing everyday evidences of God's kindness helps strengthen faith during dark and confusing seasons.
- Clinging to Scripture and mutual prayer reminds us that God remains faithful even when our faith wavers.

### This is Not How I Thought My Story Would Go
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-december-4-2020.html
Passage: Joshua 21:45
Points:
- Life often takes unexpected detours, forcing believers to choose between lingering in disappointment or trusting God's plan.
- Mary responded to sudden upheaval by recalling God's faithful character toward Israel throughout history.
- Joshua 21:45 anchors believers with the truth that none of the Lord's good promises will fail.
- Deep familiarity with God's Word enables believers to maintain a biblical perspective amid trials.
- Every individual life is part of God's larger, purposeful redemptive narrative.

### Not One of God’s Words Will Fail
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/not-one-of-gods-words-will-fail
Passage: Joshua 21:45
Points:
- Joshua declared that not one word of God's good promises failed once Israel was brought safely into the land.
- Faith is revitalized not by vague generalities, but by the concrete historical details of God fulfilling what He said.
- Long intervals between prophecy and fulfillment display God's patient sovereignty across centuries.
- Remembering God's long-term fidelity provides endurance while waiting for unfulfilled longings.
- Believers can be certain that every promise secured in Christ will be realized in the age to come.
